general.title: BOJ’s Ueda Unfazed by Consumption Drop, Stays Open to Rate Hike
general.summary: Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda said he expects consumer spending to return to a rising trend, signaling that a recent economic contraction driven by weak consumption won’t dissuade the central bank from raising its benchmark interest rate.
